title: Winter and Cellar
author: Vesper Blackwood
blurb: Tamsin Okonkwo, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
